title: Canonical weak convergence maps from finite diagonal tails
statement: For any regular limiting subobjects of the canonical cycle-boundary tower, the finite diagonal tail hypotheses imply the canonical weak convergence predicate.

proof.text: Extract the upper zero and invertible left tails from hA. Apply finiteCocone_limitCycles to identify L.Z with image initialG, and finiteCocone_limitBoundaries to identify L.B with the direct image of the transported cocone kernel.

The initial-g image equality makes its factorization into L.Z epic; composing with the cokernel projection gives an epic toPageInfinity. The image projection and cokernel projection defining toGradedPiece are epic. For a quotient B <= Z, its pulled-back kernel is B because a mono is the kernel of its cokernel.

Prove pullback of the direct image of S along f equals ker f sup S: lift along the image epimorphism after an epimorphic refinement, subtract the S-lift, factor the difference through ker f, and descend the resulting containment by cancellation of the refinement epi. The opposite inclusion is the image-pullback adjunction and the zero kernel composite.

Exactness identifies ker initialG with the incoming alpha image. The cocone equation sends this image to the next cocone image. The two quotient-kernel calculations therefore give ker initialG sup ker j and ker j sup ker initialG. Commutativity of sup gives identical kernels and assembles WeaklyConvergesTo.

lean.statement: theorem finiteCocone_weakMaps {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] (X : BigradedExactCouple C 0) (A : ∀ n : ℤ, X.AlphaColimit n) (hA : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ a b : ℤ, (∀ P : ℤ, P ≤ a → IsIso ((A n).ι P)) ∧ (∀ P : ℤ, b ≤ P → IsZero (X.D P (n - P)))) (L : X.LimitSubobjects) (hreg : X.IsRegular) : X.WeaklyConvergesTo L A
